title: Developmental Disabilities and Counseling
tagline: Counseling the whole person across the lifespan of ability.
welcome: Developmental disabilities reshape a family's story from diagnosis onward. This course teaches you to counsel the child, the adolescent, and the family with dignity and skill.
vignette: At a diagnosis feedback meeting, a mother hears 'Down syndrome' and goes quiet. The counselor's next ten minutes will shape how this family carries that name for years. Words, paced and kind, are clinical instruments.
vignette_attr: A diagnosis feedback meeting, drawn from practice
description: A course in counseling individuals with developmental disabilities and their families: major developmental disabilities and their trajectories, diagnosis disclosure and family adaptation, counseling adaptations across ability, transitions across the lifespan, and collaboration and advocacy.
questions: How do I counsel across communication differences?
How do I support a family at diagnosis and at every transition?
How do I honor autonomy and capability in every person?
importance: Families need sustained counseling across the disability lifespan
Adapted counseling is a right, not a luxury
Transitions are predictable crises; skilled support changes them
misconceptions: that people with developmental disabilities cannot benefit from counseling, when adapted counseling is effective
that the family's story ends at diagnosis, when it is a lifelong journey
figures: whose family-centered work shaped disability support
who redefined success around the whole family
which insists on the voice of the person
outcomes: You will describe presentations and lifespan courses.
You will pace feedback and family adjustment.
You will modify method and communication.
You will plan school-to-work and adult transitions.
You will work with teams and agencies.
You will champion rights and belonging.
modules: The overview grounds every later skill.
The first words echo for years.
The Sibling and the Family System
The whole family carries the journey.
School to work and adult life
integration: This elective deepens special-education and family work across the programme.
faith: Every person, of every ability, is made in the image of God and worthy of full dignity.
closing: May every family hear hope with the diagnosis, and may every person be counseled as whole.
